draft_text: Asterion outperformed RuneSpan on Meridian-QA, and Darsen and Ko found preliminary evidence that Patchwise Replay may improve exact-match accuracy on the same benchmark.
revised_text: Asterion outperformed RuneSpan on Meridian-QA (80.4% vs 78.0% exact match, a 2.4-point gain over 8 seeds), and Darsen and Ko (2023) describe a preliminary experiment applying Patchwise Replay by revisiting high-loss training passages.
rationale: T1 shows Asterion 80.4% vs RuneSpan 78.0% (2.4-point gain), supporting "outperformed." However, P1 only describes a preliminary experiment applying Patchwise Replay; it does not state that Patchwise Replay improves exact-match accuracy on Meridian-QA. That part of the claim is unsupported.
